title: Dual Co-Train: Cross-Dataset Ultrasound Tongue Segmentation Under Extreme Data Scarcity
abstract: arXiv:2608.17983v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ultrasound tongue contour segmentation remains challenging under cross-dataset domain shift, where limited annotations, probe variability, and acquisition noise often degrade model generalization. We present a source-free domain adaptation framework for robust ultrasound tongue segmentation built on a lightweight UltraUNet backbone. Starting from a checkpoint pretrained on only five labeled source images, simulating an underfitted constrained source model, the proposed method adapts to a fully-unlabeled target domain by iteratively refining pseudo-labels, filtering unreliable masks with a contour-based quality-control module, and generating target-style synthetic image-mask pairs through a segmentation-guided conditional GAN. translated_title: 双协同训练：极端数据稀缺下的跨数据集超声舌分割
translated_abstract: 超声舌轮廓分割在跨数据集域转移下仍具挑战性，其中有限的标注、探头变异和采集噪声常导致模型泛化性能下降。我们提出了一种基于轻量级UltraUNet骨干网络的源无关域适应框架，用于鲁棒的超声舌分割。从仅用五张标注源图像预训练的检查点开始，模拟欠拟合的受限源模型，该方法通过迭代优化伪标签、利用基于轮廓的质量控制模块过滤不可靠掩码，以及通过分割引导的条件生成对抗网络生成目标风格的合成图像-掩码对，适应完全无标签的目标域。随后，学生模型在清洁伪标签目标图像、带一致性正则化的噪声伪标签以及合成样本的混合数据上进行训练，实现在无需访问源数据的情况下闭环适应。
tldr: 本文提出了一种在极端数据稀缺下，利用源无关域适应和生成对抗网络，仅需五张标注图像即可实现跨数据集超声舌分割的鲁棒方法。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a source-free domain adaptation framework that, using only five labeled images and a segmentation-guided conditional GAN, achieves robust cross-dataset ultrasound tongue segmentation under extreme data scarcity.
